_comment: Gold-answer QA set for the Razer customer-companion benchmark. Each row: ask_as_user is who's posing the question (matters for cross-user disambiguation); ask_on_device is the device context. The agent should answer with the gold_answer in mind. The LLM judge compares the agent's response to the gold_answer at scoring time. Categories blend LoCoMo (single/multi-hop, temporal, adversarial) with vertical-specific ones (inventory, kb-relationship, multi-user-disambiguation, cross-device-continuity, habit-awareness). Privacy boundaries are out of scope — they require per-user permissioning at the chat layer, a separate Sonzai SDK surface that warrants its own benchmark.

qa.question: Who set up the parental controls for Lila and what voice-log policy did they pick?
qa.gold_answer: Marcus set up the parental controls for Lila during the initial desk-companion setup; he turned on weekly voice-log auto-purge (every Sunday at 2am SGT), prompted by Priya's preference.

qa.question: What's the rule I gave you about RGB?
qa.gold_answer: Priya asked the agent never to recommend RGB peripherals to her — she stated she hates RGB during her first interaction.

qa.question: What gaming mouse does Aiden currently use, and what was he using before?
qa.gold_answer: Aiden currently uses the Razer Viper V3 Pro (purchased Jan 2026 with parental approval, $90 Razer Gold + $70 from his birthday savings). Before that he used the Viper Mini Signature Edition, which was a hand-me-down from Marcus in September 2025.

qa.question: Aiden's mouse — was it bought entirely with Razer Gold? And whose savings funded the difference?
qa.gold_answer: No. The Viper V3 Pro cost about $160. Aiden contributed about $90 in Razer Gold; the remaining $70 came from his birthday savings, not Razer Gold and not the family card. Marcus approved the purchase on the condition the top-up came from birthday savings.

qa.question: Did Aiden switch his Valorant main before or after he got the new Viper V3 Pro?
qa.gold_answer: After. Aiden got the Viper V3 Pro in mid-January 2026; he switched main from Phoenix to Jett in late March 2026.

qa.gold_answer: Three teammates from Aiden's school: Ravi Subramaniam (best friend, Sage main, met in Sec 1), Daniel Lim (duelist, plays Reyna), and JK / Jeong-kyu Park (Korean exchange student, in-game leader, plays Omen).

qa.gold_answer: Marcus uses the Razer DeathAdder V3 Pro; he bought it in April 2024. Aiden does NOT use it — Aiden's mouse is the Viper V3 Pro. The agent should not confuse the two.

(This QA tests whether memory survives device switch within the same identity.)
